question: Which of these is one of the things Agur finds too amazing in Proverbs 30:18-19?
options: The way of a fish in a river
The way of a horse in battle
The way of a lion in the forest
The way of an eagle in the sky
explanation: Proverbs 30:19 lists the way of an eagle in the sky, a snake on a rock, and a ship on the high seas among the things too amazing to understand.
